name: Satanists
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practices associated with Satanists, including witchcraft, divination, and other occult activities, as seen in Exodus 22:18 and Deuteronomy 18:10. Those who align themselves with such deception follow the devil, who is described in John 8:44 as a liar and murderer from the beginning. God's judgment is certain against all who persist in disobedience and wickedness (Ephesians 5:6; Psalms 145:20), while He promises mercy and preservation to those who love Him and remain faithful (Isaiah 14:1).
